2026/04/08 22:03:32 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- supabase/migrations/20260318000000_superadmin_setup.sql\n-- ============================================================================\n-- SYSTEM LAYER: SUPER ADMIN \u0026 HELPER ROLES\n-- ============================================================================\n-- Adds the necessary system-level tables for platform owners and administrators.\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLE: SYSTEM USERS (Replaces admin_users)\n-- ============================================================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_users (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n  firebase_uid TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  \n  -- Role definitions\n  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN (\n    'super_admin',    -- Level 1: Platform Owner (Joseph)\n    'admin_helper',   -- Level 2: Team Leads (Ann)\n    'support_staff',  -- Level 3: CS Team\n    'analyst'         -- Level 4: Read-Only\n  )),\n  \n  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,\n  \n  -- Record who created this admin account\n  created_by UUID REFERENCES system_users(id),\n  \n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

-- ============================================================================                                 
-- SECURE FUNCTIONS FOR SYSTEM ROLES                                                                            
-- ============================================================================                                 
                                                                                                                
-- Utility function to easily check if the current user is a system admin                                       
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_system_admin(minimum_role TEXT DEFAULT NULL)                                      
RETURNS BOOLEAN                                                                                                 
SET search_path = public                                                                                        
AS $$                                                                                                           
DECLARE                                                                                                         
  user_role TEXT;                                                                                               
  user_active BOOLEAN;                                                                                          
BEGIN                                                                                                           
  -- Fetch caching status                                                                                       
  SELECT role, is_active INTO user_role, user_active                                                            
  FROM system_users                                                                                             
  WHERE firebase_uid = public.firebase_uid();                                                                   
                                                                                                                
  -- Must exist and be active                                                                                   
  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT user_active THEN                                                                          
    RETURN FALSE;                                                                                               
  END IF;                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                
  -- If a required role is specified, evaluate permission hierarchy                                             
  IF minimum_role IS NOT NULL THEN                                                                              
    IF minimum_role = 'super_admin' AND user_role != 'super_admin' THEN                                         
      RETURN FALSE;                                                                                             
    END IF;                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                
    IF minimum_role = 'admin_helper' AND user_role NOT IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper') THEN                  
      RETURN FALSE;                                                                                             
    END IF;                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                
    IF minimum_role = 'support_staff' AND user_role NOT IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper', 'support_staff') THEN
      RETURN FALSE;                                                                                             
    END IF;                                                                                                     
  END IF;                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                
  RETURN TRUE;                                                                                                  
END;                                                                                                            
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
